equation_summary: Simple GLA keeps a matrix state S[B,H,K,V] with a per-HEAD, per-token data-dependent gate: gk = logsigmoid(gk_proj(x)) / gate_logit_normalizer has shape [B,T,H], and S_t = exp(gk_t[h]) * S_{t-1} + k_t^T v_t, o_t = (q_t*scale) S_t (after-update read). The gate is a scalar per head per timestep (head scope), produced by an external projection of the hidden states.
ledger_verdicts: CONFIRM E[QKV/head gate]: gk_proj outputs num_heads scalars, so the gate is head-scalar, matching the ledger's 'head gate'/'head decay'
CONFIRM the update is exactly U2.A with a head-scalar decay gate: S = S*exp(g) + k^T v; o = q*S

CORRECT the gate is data-dependent (logsigmoid of a learned projection of x_t), i.e. time-varying, unlike the static Lightning/RetNet decay; it still fits the head gate scope of U2.A because the gate is supplied as an operand
CONFIRM blockers: gate VJP and low-precision chunk path, B[K2_graph_execution]
direction_justification: Simple GLA is exactly U2.A with a head-scalar decay gate supplied as a data-dependent operand; the gate's data-dependence is external to the mixer law, so it composes once K2 graph execution exists.
open_questions: Whether the K2 head-gate descriptor requires the gate tensor to be materialized per-token (it is here) or admits a broadcast scalar; the source always materializes [B,T,H].
evidence_citations: fla/ops/simple_gla/naive.py:83-91 — S = S*gate.unsqueeze(-1,-1) + k^T v; o = (q*S).sum: after-update read, gate broadcast over [K,V]
fla/layers/simple_gla.py:145 — gk_proj = Linear(hidden_size, num_heads): gate is per-head scalar
fla/layers/simple_gla.py:236 — gk = logsigmoid(gk)/gate_logit_normalizer: data-dependent per-token head gate
